summary: Two dismissible alerts, an info one with a title and a warning one, that are replaced by a short dismissed note once closed.
use: Inline notices the user can dismiss, such as beta-feature banners or storage warnings.
spec: `<Alert severity="info" title="Heads up" closable onclose={() => (closedInfo = true)}>` with beta-feature text
`<Alert severity="warning" closable onclose={() => (closedWarn = true)}>` with a storage 85% full message, no title
`let closedInfo = $state(false)` and `let closedWarn = $state(false)` track each alert

`{#if !closedInfo}` and `{#if !closedWarn}` render the alert, `{:else}` renders a `

` note
